summary: {person} checks which passengers a proposed fare increase actually covers.
realLife: The October Transit Plus briefing described proposed fixed-route fare increases while reporting that paratransit fares would stay level in 2026.
gates: The fare proposal distinguishes fixed-route and paratransit riders.
weights: An announcement using a single headline price can confuse riders of the other service.
inGame: needs: mode-specific proposed fares, current fares and stage of adoption.

turns.what: The office checks that service’s own fare schedule.
turns.writesBack: Record the answer with the mode named.

turns.what: The office checks the concession rate in the proposal.
turns.pulledBy: A caller rides a regular bus at a reduced fare.
